description: This file defines a utility enum 'KeychainStore' providing static methods to load, save, and delete string values in the keychain, acting as a wrapper around 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' for secure storage operations.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Loads a string value from the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain entry for the specified service and account.
